title: Grilled Corn Arepa with Italian Seasoning
description: A flavorful arepa dish topped with grilled corn, melted cheese, and a sprinkle of Italian seasoning.
instructions: Brush corn with olive oil and season with Italian seasoning.
Grill corn for 5-7 minutes, turning occasionally.
Grill arepas for 2-3 minutes, until lightly toasted.
Slice grilled corn off the cob.
Assemble arepas by spreading cheese on the bottom half and topping with grilled corn.
Place the other half of the arepa on top.
